gate: F3 Motion lowering Z convention and camera-backed 2.5D depth ordering
fixture: Two opaque PNG cards, no mesh: blue stays at RenderPlan Z=80; red moves from Z=20 to Z=150 between frames 0 and 1. Camera and card state are lowered by CM3D; C3D renders software raw RGBA8.
motion_assertions: camera_samples and both cards use the same frames 0 and 1
red card base position and resolved transform samples use mirrored Z values +20 and +150
Null/controller layers are absent from the renderable plan
result: PASS: the rendered front/back order flips exactly when the animated PNG card crosses the other card in Z.
limits: This validates the Z lowering and image-card depth order in the software renderer. It does not validate the separate Documentary Showcase highlighter alignment, Vulkan mesh intersection, or AE parity.
